description: This file defines the `KeyHandler` class responsible for generating, reading, and managing cryptographic keys within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to create new keys, read existing ones, verify existence, and retrieve file paths.

classes.name: KeyHandler
classes.description: A utility class for managing cryptographic keys, including creation, retrieval, and existence checks.

methods.name: createKey
methods.description: Generates a new cryptographic key, saves it to a file, and handles exceptions during the process.

methods.name: readKey
methods.description: Reads the existing key from a file, caching it for subsequent calls, and throws exceptions if the key does not exist or isn't readable.

methods.name: keyExists
methods.description: Checks if the key file exists by verifying the validity of its path.

methods.name: getRealPathToKey
methods.description: Returns the absolute, real filesystem path to the key file, or null if it does not exist.

methods.name: getPathToKey
methods.description: Constructs the expected filesystem path to the key file based on system configuration.
